definitions.explanation: An academic lecture or class, typically at a university or college level. Can also refer to the act of giving a lecture.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{講義|こうぎ}が{三|みっ}つあります。
{教授|きょうじゅ}の{講義|こうぎ}はとても{面白|おもしろ}い。
examples.english: The professor's lectures are very interesting.

notes:
{講義|こうぎ} refers specifically to academic lectures, typically at universities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {講義|こうぎ}を{受|う}ける: to attend/take a lecture
- {講義|こうぎ}をする: to give a lecture
- {講義|こうぎ}に{出|で}る: to attend a lecture
- {講義|こうぎ}{室|しつ}: lecture room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {授業|じゅぎょう}: class (more general, used for all levels)
- セミナー: seminar (smaller, more interactive)
- {講演|こうえん}: public lecture, speech
